output.title: ACME profiles extension support enhances ACME protocol capabilities
output.content: This change adds support for the ACME profiles extension, extending cert-manager's ACME protocol capabilities. The environment uses cert-manager with Certificate resources, which typically rely on ACME for certificate issuance. This extension support is now available for ACME-based certificate workflows. The feature is backward compatible and plausibly applies to any ACME users in this environment.
